facts.fact: The brass button token was stitched into the spine of the count; Meera picks three binding stitches loose with her thumbnail and a tooth to free it, leaving the spine gaping.
Crate marks on Meera's redbark drops: a bell scored through the stamp, then the stamp scraped off with a spoon in a left-handed scrape. Her page records ten winters of drops.
Rohan, bound by his promise of no more questions, stops himself at 'May I' and rephrases as an offer; Meera notes 'nearly's free'.
